## Open

### T-160 — The kopi template copies generated report folders into a new realm

> _2026-09-27 · core/blong-kopi · open_

A scaffolded realm arrives with .ci-report/ (report.json, tap.json, summary.md, history.jsonl and a
publish directory) and .github/memory/ copied from the template, which the README's list of what
gets scaffolded does not mention: TEMPLATE_FILES_IGNORE in core/blong-lib/template.ts does not
exclude them, so another project's reports and memory entries land in a new realm. The generated
package.json also copies the template's version verbatim and keeps the bare realm name, where the
README's step tells the author to rename it to the scoped package name. Clean both up in the ignore
list and the version substitution.
